question: Alternatives: parallel or checkpointed recovery, scalar compression.
number: The walk is sequential (x -> f(x)), so 7 lanes cannot split it; a scalar compression costs 638 ops against 595 for the 7-lane batch used with 1-2 lanes, so the batch is cheaper. Checkpoints need memory: headroom 82,304 B holds 2,572 entries of 32 B for 18,432 trails, which cannot shorten the walk of the one trail pair in general. No alternative beats the shipped walk.
